design_philosophy: The spec-maxed 14" Lunar Lake convertible: OLED touch, Arc 140V, and 1TB in the efficient Copilot+ chassis — the config to buy when panel quality and storage matter more than price. At regular price it is out-valued by the discounted Panther Lake tier.
